newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia forex reserves at $16.574 bln in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia forex reserves at $16.574 bln in Oct.

text.p: Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves had risen to $16.574 billion in October from $16.414 billion in September, banking sources said on Tuesday.
They said the rise was due to dollar-buying by the central bank last month to ensure the U.S. currency remained within the central bank's intervention band.
Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves in August totalled $16.428 billion and $16.450 billion in July.
